address: 44 Mac Thi Buoi Street, Saigon Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: Set over three floors, the restaurant features a bar and counter seating around an open kitchen on the ground floor, while upstairs, heavy leather chairs, dark wood wainscoting and antler chandeliers evoke classic steakhouse style. Grass-fed and grain-fed beef steaks are the house specialities, particularly those dry-aged for over 21 days. A range of house-made sauces, each carefully crafted, complements the beef and caters to a wide range of tastes. The creamy mashed potato, cooked over a wood fire, is richly smoky. Finish with a glass of your favourite whisky.
